item.title: Self-Hosted Email Security Gateways: Proxmox Mail Gateway vs Scrollout F1 vs MailScanner
item.description:
Introduction

Email remains the number one attack vector for organizations of all sizes. Phishing, malware attachments, spam, and business email compromise (BEC) attacks all enter through the same channel: inbound SMTP. Placing an email security gateway in front of your mail server adds a critical defense layer that inspects every message before it reaches user inboxes.

item.title: Best Self-Hosted Antivirus & Malware Scanning Tools for Linux Servers in 2026
item.description: Running your own servers means taking responsibility for their security. While firewalls and intrusion detection systems protect against network-level threats, you also need on-host malware scanning to catch malicious files, rootkits, and trojans that bypass perimeter defenses.
